Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a production-quality Chinese mobile fantasy tower-defense game UI art mockup, one complete screen, not a collage or art presentation board.
Input image 1 is the exact current screen to refine. Preserve its battlefield scene, overall layout, element centers, typography scale, information, button count, button positions and hierarchy. This is a visual skin refinement, not a new layout. Keep the existing warm comic fantasy illustration style and strong clean silhouettes. Work in the same portrait aspect ratio as the input, at high resolution.
Shared art direction across this three-screen set: warm ivory parchment (#F6EBD2) where a paper panel already exists; near-white inset reward cards; deep navy text; navy iron title plates; restrained antique gold hairline trim, clean clipped corners and tiny diamond line dividers. Existing illustrated reward icons and crown/ribbon identity must stay recognizable. Use subtle continuous tonal shading and fine top highlights; avoid broad stripes, visible gradient bands, chunky double frames, excessive decorative hardware, realistic 3D, noisy texture, modern sci-fi UI. Functional buttons remain single-layer cut-corner gold or green, with one narrow highlight and a fine contour. No big extra paper board, no redesigned navigation, no phone bezel, no browser chrome, no footer outside the game, no annotations, no new headline or explanatory text. Text must be accurate Simplified Chinese, crisp and readable. No giant polygon sunburst, hard light beams, excessive particles or fullscreen white flare. A tiny local soft glow is acceptable. Show the settled final state, not motion blur.
PAUSE SCREEN ONLY. Keep the original relatively compact navy-and-gold pause title at the top, improve its edge craftsmanship with fine pale-gold trim and subdued navy face. Title is exactly "暂 停". Remove the purple GM developer button. The battlefield under the modal remains darkened but visible. Under the title, keep the existing "已获得奖励" label and its two free-standing circular reward sockets in their current positions, no full-size paper container. Give the coin and experience sockets clean restrained metal rims and a gentle inner cream light; preserve the original crown coin and scroll illustrations. Keep quantities directly beneath: "0" below the coin and "4" below the scroll, same scale. Use slender gold decorative divider lines framing "已获得奖励". Preserve the large deliberate empty middle space.
Bottom remains the existing connected THREE tabs in exactly the same row and proportions, selected left tab gold and other two navy, exact labels: "奖励总览", "伤害统计", "设置". Improve the clipped corners, spacing within their bounds, subdued inner top hairline, no separate floating buttons. Bottom row: existing left gold "⏻ 退出", right green "▶ 继续战斗", no new buttons. Do not enlarge the pause title into a crown or add victory motifs. Overall result should feel cleaner, quieter and more refined than the reference, fully consistent with an ivory-and-navy illustrated fantasy game.
